exclusions.source_text: Have a history of another primary cancer, with the exception of: a) curatively resected non-melanoma skin cancer; b) curatively treated carcinoma in situ; or c) pT1-2 prostatic cancer Gleason score \<6 or d) participant is free of other primary solid or liquid tumor for ≥ 1 year prior to the start of study treatment and, in the opinion of the Investigator, the disease will not affect participant's outcome in the setting of current chondrosarcoma diagnosis.
exclusions.threshold: free of other primary tumor for >= 1 year

exclusions.source_text: Have significant active cardiac disease within 6 months prior to randomization, including New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class III or IV congestive heart failure; myocardial infarction; unstable angina; and/or stroke.
exclusions.threshold: within 6 months; NYHA Class III or IV

exclusions.source_text: Have LVEF \<40% by ECHO scan (or by other methods according to institutional practice) obtained within 28 days prior to randomization.

Have a heart-rate corrected QT interval (using Fridericia's formula) (QTcF) ≥ 450 msec or other factors that increase the risk of QT prolongation or arrhythmic events (eg, heart failure, hypokalemia, family history of long QT interval syndrome).
